text:
amy: acme POC stuck — function calls returning parse/validation errors and we're also hitting 429s. customer says they can't proceed, asking for a quick swarm.

michael_acme: Repro steps from their engineer: call tool 'create_order' using our schema. Getting a SchemaValidationFailed saying response was not JSON.
```json
Error: SchemaValidationFailed
expected: {"type":"object","properties":{"order_id":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"}}}
received: "Received text: 'Order created! id=abc123'"
```

juan: can you paste the raw assistant response (including function_call if present) and the exact request payload? also which model & client headers are you using?

michael_acme: sending payload now — cURL:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
 -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX"
 -H "Content-Type: application/json"
 -d '{
  "model":"redwood/tiny-instruct-rc",
  "input":"create order for 3 widgets",
  "tools": ["create_order"],
  "json_mode":"strict",
  "max_tokens":200
}'
```

liang: quick read — json_mode:"strict" forces exact JSON-only output. smaller instruction-tuned models sometimes emit human text around calls. two practical unblocks: 1) set json_mode:"relaxed" (accepts JSON inside text), or 2) use a chat-style model + explicit function_call: {"name":"create_order"} to force invocation. also consider switching model to redwood/chat-1-large for more deterministic function behavior.

juan: logging shows a bunch of 429s too. sample:
```text
[2026-03-20T14:04:02Z] request_id=abcde status=429 qps=6 route=/generate
```
Default hosted QPS is 5 for this tier — @amy we can temporarily bump to 20 for the POC, do you want me to request it?

liang: +1, I can ping infra for a short-term bump. amy confirm we should request.

amy: yes please bump, customer needs it today.

kate-sec: heads up — acme will ask the usual security questionnaire items (data retention, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options). I have our standard answers and compliance deck ready in the drive. @amy please share the customer's legal/security contact so I can DM them.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of parser-strict-fix to staging at 14:18 UTC.

juan: pushing a suggested config to the customer: switch to json_mode:"relaxed" and explicitly set function_call name. also include a concrete function schema with amount as a number. example:
```json
{"function_schema": {
 "name": "create_order",
 "parameters": {
   "type": "object",
   "properties": {
     "order_id": {"type":"string"},
     "amount": {"type":"number"}
   },
   "required": ["order_id","amount"]
 }
}}
```

michael_acme: tried the change, new error now: "Invalid function signature: missing required field 'amount'" — our frontend is sending amount as a string (e.g. "3").

juan: that explains it — the schema expects a number. quick fix in the frontend: ensure amount is serialized as a number, e.g. `payload.params = { order_id: "tmp", amount: Number(amount) }`.

liang: also recommendation: add client-side response_schema validation to catch mismatches before we call into the function layer. if 429 persists after QPS bump we'll route the POC to a dedicated cluster for predictable throughput.

michael_acme: updating frontend now, retesting.

amy: ETA on infra bump & can you send the security deck?

liang: requesting POC QPS bump with infra now, ETA ~30m. kate-sec will send deck in DM.

kate-sec: sent deck to michael_acme via email, cc amy.

michael_acme: update — after frontend change it works for small batches, but at higher concurrency we're still seeing 429s. can we get short-term quota increase for the POC?

amy: noted — I'll coordinate purchase + short-term quota upgrade while infra completes the bump.

juan: follow-up suggestion for customer docs — include a tiny snippet for robust function calling: parse and coerce primitives, explicit schema on both ends, and fallback parsing logic. I'll drop the snippet in the docs channel.

michael_acme: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
